a.xlink:title: The message and the fix of firstDiagnostic, for a dialog; empty without a diagnostic.
Writes one scenario as a standalone scenario file, replacing the file at filePath.
A message for the status bar, shown for timeoutMs milliseconds.
True when wroteAll is set and no diagnostic is an error.
The first error among the diagnostics, else the first diagnostic, else null.
A Yes or No question whose default answer is No; true for Yes. It asks also in a suppressed run.
The path for a UTF-8 name. Text that cannot be converted as UTF-8 is read in the system code page,...
Lists the scenarios again and shows the selected one.
Writes the label of each scenario in the list again.
False while no scene is loaded or a run uses it.
True when a scene is loaded.
Selects the scenario with the id id.
Shows the fields of the selected scenario again.
The scenario of a case that stores none: id "baseline", no incidents and no entrance delays.
The selected scenario or its id or name has changed, or the document is replaced; the argument is hea...
A count with the noun that fits it, such as "1 error" or "2 errors".
The scenario id was edited since the scene was saved.
Takes the text of a field that is being edited into the document, as if the user had left the field.
True when a diagnostic has severity Error.
The folder that holds the case at casePath, a scene folder or a bundle, or the empty string.
